Text.description: Paragraph; text can mix strings and nodes.

Markdown.description: Native prose, lists, code and tables; no external resources.

Button.description: Click action. With no action, sends its label to the assistant. size sm/md/lg selects 32/40/48px. Buttons fill Grid cells and button-only Rows. Omit size on short-label keypad keys for adaptive height: 0.8 times column width, clamped to 40–56px; explicit size overrides it.

Chart.description: Native chart. Rows of data; x is the category key (numeric for scatter); series defaults to numeric keys other than x (up to 8). Percent values are like 45, not 0.45; currency is an ISO code like EUR. Stacking applies to bar/area; height clamps to 140–480 px.

Table.description: Native sortable, resizable table. Each row lists cells in column order; cells may be components. Numeric columns align right.

TextArea.description: Multiline text field bound to a $variable; rows clamps to 2–20.

SegmentedControl.description: Two to four short choices. Options are strings or {value,label}; block fills the available width.

RadioGroup.description: Single choice. list uses radio buttons; pills uses segmented choices; cards includes descriptions.

DatePicker.description: Native calendar picker; value/min/max use YYYY-MM-DD.

Timer.description: Countdown with start/pause/reset; decrements bound seconds to zero. Pauses when the card leaves the visual tree.

IconButton.description: Icon-only button. Supply a label for accessibility; no implicit assistant action. size sm/md/lg selects 32/40/48px.

Pressable.description: Keyboard-accessible clickable tile; nested controls retain their own input.

Box.description: Flex container, column by default. Lengths are pixels or percentages; gap/padding are 4px steps.

Grid.description: Equal columns (default 2, maximum 12); minChildWidth reduces columns on narrow cards.

Spacer.description: Fills free space in a Row.

Carousel.description: Horizontally scrolling native items; itemWidth defaults to 240 px (80–640).

Popover.description: Click trigger to show content in a native flyout. Slots are strings or lists of components.

Link.description: http(s) external link; always asks for confirmation showing the full URL.

ListItem.description: List entry; marker replaces its bullet/number, e.g. a time or emoji.

List.description: List of strings/ListItem; timeline connects markers.

Quote.description: Quotation/callout with a side rule and optional attribution.

Code.description: Native code block with copy; never executes code.

Math.description: LaTeX source displayed as native text in v1 (not typeset).

Flashcard.description: Tap to flip front/back; flip state is retained with the card.

Celebration.description: Native celebratory feedback when the condition changes from false to true.

Image.description: User/tool-provided HTTPS image. Never fetched automatically: a 点击加载 placeholder shows the full URL first. No automatic search fallback.

SearchImage.description: Photo-search card with a confirmed external search link; no automatic network requests or in-app image search.

Icon.description: Lucide-style name mapped to native Segoe Fluent Icons.

MapMarker.description: Location marker with latitude and longitude; rendered as a selectable location card.

Map.description: Static native location cards, not a map service. Selecting updates selected to the marker label; coordinates open externally only after confirmation. route lists locations in order (no routing/network).

YouTube.description: Known YouTube video ID/URL rendered as a native preview card and confirmed external link; no embedded player or automatic thumbnail request.

Svg.description: Native vector drawing with viewBox scaling. Shapes accept expressions; no HTML/SVG document execution or resources.

G.description: Drawing group. Transforms: translate, rotate, scale, skewX, skewY, matrix with numeric arguments.

Path.description: Vector path, commands M/L/H/V/C/S/Q/T/A/Z only, never resource URLs.

SvgText.description: Drawing text at x/y; anchor controls horizontal alignment.
